rows.title: BITSCROW contract-state digest
rows.notes: Unkeyed BLAKE2b, 32-byte digest of canonical contract state. Same primitive as fork PoW (blake2b-256) but a different message. Not blake2s, not blake2b-512, not a keyed MAC.

rows.title: Fork txid / block hash algorithm
rows.source: Knots v29.4.1.knots20260508 src/primitives/block.cpp GetHash + src/crypto/blake2b.h blake2b_nokey; Knots PR 385 independent recompute of height 961640; bitcoin-blake2b.org developers (first BLAKE2b block 961640, 30 Aug 2026)
rows.value: txid/wtxid: SHA256d (unchanged). Block hash from height 961640: unkeyed BLAKE2b-256 (blake2b_nokey, outlen=32), two-pass Knots header-v2 construction over an 80-byte ASIC work header, not a single hash of the 164-byte wire header. Not blake2s, not blake2b-512, not keyed, not Sia personalization.
rows.notes: Pre-961640 blocks on this branch remain SHA256d. Do not treat bitscrow-digest as the block hash. Merkle root feeding H1 is still SHA256d.
